scripts.config:diff: dotenvx run -f supabase/.env -fk .env.keys -- supabase config diff
scripts.config:push: dotenvx run -f supabase/.env -fk .env.keys -- supabase config push
scripts.config:pull: dotenvx run -f supabase/.env -fk .env.keys -- supabase config pull
scripts.secrets:set: dotenvx decrypt -f supabase/functions/.env -fk .env.keys --stdout | supabase secrets set --env-file /dev/stdin
scripts.build:email: mkdir -p supabase/templates/dist && npx mjml supabase/templates/*.mjml -o supabase/templates/dist
